title: clinarmonize/clinicalharmonize pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the two-level (cohort, dataset) samplesheet provided with params.input. A cohort holds many datasets; (cohort_id, dataset_id) is the primary key, not cohort_id alone (see §1.1 Trap). Duplicate-key detection deliberately lives outside this schema, in subworkflows/local/ingest, so the failure names both offending rows -- nf-schema's own `uniqueEntries` only names one.

cohort_id.errorMessage: cohort_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

dataset_id.errorMessage: dataset_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

role.errorMessage: role must be one of: clinical, treatment, biopsy, imaging, other. It is declared here, never inferred from the file name.

path.errorMessage: path must point to an existing file

holdout.errorMessage: holdout must be provided as true or false. A sheet lacking this column is rejected; absent is not false.
